instruction: Add and run the missing lifecycle-only base-sync merge negative regression, then regenerate SHA-bound verification evidence for the resulting reviewed head.

findings.summary: The regression suite covers managed-artifact-only base-sync merges but does not cover the separately required lifecycle-only base-sync merge boundary.

evidence_refs.lines: The added merge-negative test covers only a task-side managed evaluator artifact; no lifecycle-only base-sync merge fixture is added.
Evidence reports semantic base-sync selection and managed-artifact-only rejection, but not lifecycle-only merge rejection.
